title: Teen Mom's Tyler Baltierra Praises Wife Catelynn Lowell's 30-Lb Weight Loss Transformation
text:
Teen Mom's Tyler Baltierra Reveals Catelynn Lowell’s 30-Lb Weight Loss 
 E!'s The Golden Life
 Watch Episode 2 Now! News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Teen Mom 's Tyler Baltierra Praises Wife Catelynn Lowell's 30-Lb Weight Loss Transformation
 Teen Mom star Tyler Baltierra shared photos of his wife Catelynn Lowell’s weight loss transformation, revealing she’s lost 30 pounds: “I’m so beyond proud of her!”
 By Paige Catton Nov 01, 2026 8:36 PM Tags Teen Mom Couples Weight Loss Celebrities Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Teen Mom's Tyler Baltierra Shares the "Only Way" He and Catelynn Lowell Can Contact Daughter Carly Tyler Baltierra  is detailing Catelynn Lowell ’s major transformation. 
 The Teen Mom alum shared Lowell has dropped 30 pounds since kicking off her health journey while sharing family photos from Halloween.
 “Can we just take a moment to acknowledge how beautiful my wife is!?” Baltierra wrote on Instagram Nov. 1. “She’s down 30lbs & I’m so beyond proud of her!”
 “This is what we should all be talking about in regard to our Halloween photos,” he continued. “I love you babe @catelynnmtv & you’re always the most beautiful to me! #MyBabe #Soulmate #Queen #SexyWitch.”
 In his post, Baltierra—dad to Nova , 11, Vaeda , 7, and Rya , 4, with Lowell, as well as Carly , 16, whom they place for adoption in 2009—showed off the reality star’s transformation, sharing before-and-after photos of his wife dressed in a witch costume from a previous year and this year.
 The 34-year-old shed more light on Lowell’s new slimmed-down look when he gave an inside look into the family’s Halloween celebrations.
 read Teen Mom 's Tyler Baltierra Shares the "Only Way" He and Catelynn Lowell Can Contact Daughter Carly  And Baltierra proved their family takes the holiday seriously, revealing their spook-tacular costumes.
 While Lowell, 34, twinned with their youngest daughter Rya with matching purple-and-black with costumes, Nova and Vaeda went as a Stick Man and Pennywise the Clown, respectively. As for Baltierra? The podcast host dressed as DC superhero Nightwing.
 Alongside the fun shots, the MTV star captioned his Oct. 31 Instagram post, “HAPPY HALLOWEEN from The Baltierra’s[sic]!”
 Though Lowell hasn’t directly addressed her weight loss journey, she didn’t hesitate to slam speculation in the past that her husband criticizes her body.
 “If I was ever being body-shamed or called out of my name in front of my kids, I would be gone,” she shared during an episode of Page Six’s Virtual Reali-Tea podcast in 2023. “Because I don’t want my children to think that that’s OK to be treated like that.”
 Instagram/Tyler Baltierra And she has always publicly expressed her support for her husband on his wellness journey.
 Case in point? In August 2022, Baltierra revealed his 24-pound weight loss while giving an update on his fitness goals, writing on Instagram at the time, “I’m pretty happy with the results. It makes me even more pumped to see how the next cut goes after I’m done bulking again!”
 And while he admitted he still had a “long way to go,” Lowell sent her praise in the comments section with a flirty comment.
 As she wrote, “Ayeeee my sexy man.”
 For a closer look at the couple’s sweet moments at home with their family, keep reading…
 Instagram/Tyler Baltierra Snow Fun
 Do you want to build a snowman? Just ask Tyler Balitierra and his three daughters Nova , Vaeda and Rya —who he shares with T een Mom 's Catelynn Lowell —as they headed out for some winter fun in 2024.
 Instagram/Tyler Baltierra Young Parents
 In 2009, Catelyn and Tyler welcomed daughter Carly , who they placed in an open adaption.
 Instagram Biggest Cheerleaders
 The couple cheered on their daughter Nova at a cheerleading competition in 2023.
 Instagram Christmas Time
 Nova, Vaeda and Rya all gathered under the Christmas tree in 2023.
 Instagram Father-Daughter Time
 "I can't believe how fast she's growing," Tyler shared on Instagram when celebrating Nova's last day of school in 2019. "Watching her grow up is the most beautiful thing I've ever witnessed & being her father is literally a dream come true! She's growing into such a beautiful, independent & fierce little girl & I can't wait to see what next year holds for her!" 
 Instagram Kisses for Days
 There's nothing quite like a sibling bond. Fortunately, Catelynn  captured this candid moment between Nova and Vaeda   on social media in 2019. 
 Instagram Dad's Best Friends
 "Blessed beyond belief that I had these 2 beautiful girls under my arms for date night last night!" Tyler shared on Instagram in 2019 after enjoying a quite night in. 
 Instagram Sisterly Bond
 When celebrating Carly 's 10th birthday in 2019, Tyler shared a special photo of his eldest daughter he placed up for adoption with his wife with their daughter Nova.
 "10 years ago...your life changed so many others for the better & has blessed more lives than I can count, " he wrote . "We love you so much & hopefully get to see you soon baby girl. Happy Birthday Carly! #Adoption." 
 Instagram Nova and Me
 How is it being a big sister to Vaeda? Based on this photo, life is pretty darn sweet! 
 Brittni Marie Photography/@brittnimariephotography Big Sister Duties
 "The love I have for these girls is SO unbelievably HUGE!!" Catelynn wrote on Instagram in 2019. "I'm so blessed to be the mommy to them!!!"
 Instagram In Awe
 Tyler, Catelynn and Nova all look on in fascination at fireworks on July 4, 2017.
